interpretation: Instrumentation detects a mapped window (positive control). Empty-profile offline Slack binds the Wayland registry but maps no window in 75 s, matching earlier experiments; the cause (no network/login vs. sandbox) is what the approved real-profile run decides.

rootCause.finding: Slack boot reads /etc/os-release and an /etc/*-release file; missing in the sandbox -> unhandled "No unique release file found!" in the environment step, boot stalls before any window (seen in Slack's own browser.log of the empty dry-run profile).

afterFix.behaviour: offline error page ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED, then window closed ~14 s later

docs.electron: Context7 /electron/electron: Electron 38 defaults --ozone-platform=auto (native Wayland when XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland); ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT removed in 38
docs.slack: official Linux help covers install only (Ubuntu/RHEL), no Wayland/proxy/keyring guidance
